outcome: passed: T003: lightning_export.read_runs reads each attempt of the named runs through the SPEC-074 adapter (rollout_triplets), joins task and group ids from the content-free rollout records, and yields one item per model call with its turn index and the adapter's attempt-<hmac16> pseudonym; select keeps the exportable items in order and counts every other one under exactly one reason. In a temporary store with one rollout of three model calls (full content, prompt only, no content) and consent redacted for rollout, one record is kept and two are counted content-missing; after lowering consent to none all three are consent-none; with consent redacted but only loom listed all three are no-consent. Kept plus excluded equals the model calls. Unit cases: a record that is not a triplet, has no redaction object, or has scanClean false or not true is unredacted; a missing prompt or response is content-missing; consent reasons win over content reasons; a gate refusal maps to its reason and an unknown one fails closed to no-consent. The raw attempt id never appears in items or selections; a missing run refuses with store-missing and a rollout without a rollout record with source-invalid, with fixed texts naming neither id and no chained cause. Negative control: classifying from the triplet's losses alone (without the gate refusal) reports an unlisted source as consent-none, which the no-consent test catches.
